purpose: Document independent city-specific registry discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Chinese searches found an official Jiyuan real-estate registration center announcement for the local '以图查房' visual cadastral-map service. The official service entry page was reachable, but the map route redirected to a government login flow. The linked public map app exposed encrypted configuration/API responses and did not yield an anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody is evidenced, so registryFound is true. The official announcement identifies the Jiyuan demonstration-zone real-estate registration center and natural-resources bureau as operators of the map/query service. Geometry access and runtime qualification remain held.
